answer_1.quote: In this paper we specifically focus on finding accuracy mistakes in English language sports stories. However, we believe the techniques could also be applied to other types of texts produced by data-to-text systems, including financial reports and medical patient information.
answer_1.outputs: generated texts (sports stories, financial reports, medical patient information)

answer_2.quote: We used an extended version of the RG annotation algorithm which detects additional relations such as the day of the week each game was played on and subsequent opponents for each team.

answer_4.quote: We asked three Mechanical Turkers to annotate the 21 stories, using the procedure described above.
answer_4.guideline: We ask annotators to categorise errors into one of the following categories: Incorrect number, Incorrect named entity, Incorrect word, Context error, Not checkable, Other.
